services.desc: Any bag larger than 11” x 17” x 6” (28cm x 43cm x 20cm) will not be allowed into the galleries. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, and New Year’s Day. Open 11 am - 3 pm Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve. Closed on July 4. Are you a passionate art lover looking to deepen your appreciation for the arts? Look no further than becoming an NSU Art Museum member! Our memberships offer access to our world-renowned exhibitions, engaging events, and educational programs. Plus, you’ll receive special discounts at our Museum Store and Café. Seize this opportunity to become a part of our vibrant community of art enthusiasts. Join us today and start experiencing all that NSU Art Museum has to offer! NSU
